# Project styling instructions

Use a black and yellow visual theme for the calculator app.

## Design preferences
- Primary background: black or very dark charcoal
- Accent color: yellow, gold, or warm amber
- Use high contrast text for readability
- Keep the UI clean, modern, and minimal
- Prefer sharp edges or slight rounding only for buttons and panels
- Buttons should feel tactile with subtle hover and active states

## Color palette
- Background: #0b0b0b, #111111, #1a1a1a
- Panel/background surfaces: #1f1f1f
- Accent/yellow: #facc15, #fbbf24, #f59e0b
- Text: #f5f5f5 or #fff7d6
- Secondary text: #d4d4d4

## Styling rules
- Keep the layout simple and calculator-focused
- Use yellow for operators and highlights
- Use dark neutral surfaces for the display and keypad
- Ensure buttons are large and easy to tap/click
- Maintain readable spacing and consistent sizing
- Avoid bright multi-color themes; keep the palette restrained to black + yellow tones

## Code guidance
- Prefer CSS variables for theme colors
- Keep styles organized and easy to maintain
- Use responsive layout styling so the app works well on narrow screens
- Preserve the current calculator functionality while matching this theme
